gap:
In Upcoming, where every next occurrence lands, the open card of an occurrence closes by itself when its row moves, even though the to-do never leaves the list. What the person types next is lost, and if the title field is empty at that moment the occurrence is deleted.

SEED: desktop 1200x800, America/New_York, clock Tue 2026-03-10 09:00, lists as in recur-check (project p_house). Todos: t0 'Dentist' {when:'2026-03-13', project:'p_house'} and t1 'Change water filter' {when:'2026-03-20', project:'p_house', repeat:{mode:'completion',every:1,unit:'week'}}.

STEPS (#/upcoming, one tab, repeat-engine path):
1. Double-click the t1 row to open its card.
2. Click the notes and type 'Used the spare cartridge'.
3. Press Cmd+K. It is done early, and the next occurrence lands on Tue Mar 17, in a section above it. The card stays open with focus in the notes.
4. Press Cmd+K again to undo. The next occurrence is taken back.
5. Keep typing 'Next-time-buy-two'.

EXPECTED: t1 is still in Upcoming, so its card stays open with focus in the notes and the text goes there, as it does with the same steps in #/project/p_house. CONTRACT: 'Cmd/Ctrl+K in the open card works wherever its focus is ... and acts on the card's to-do, like its checkbox. A card or selection whose to-do leaves the list on screen ... closes or is dropped with it'. Also 'Escape in the title still restores the old one, unless completing or reopening from the card has already committed it', which means the card is still open after reopening from it. This counts as a break because something the user typed is lost.

ACTUAL (2/2 clean runs, no page errors): after the second Cmd+K the card is closed and focus is on BODY. The typed text goes into Quick Find (qf-input = 'Next-time-buy-two'). Stored t1.notes = 'Used the spare cartridge', so the typed text is lost. Control in #/project/p_house: the card stays open and notes = 'Used the spare cartridgeNext-time-buy-two'.

SAME CAUSE, MORE COMMON TRIGGER: rescheduling an occurrence from its open card in Upcoming. Seed t1 'Water plants' {when:'2026-03-12', weekly schedule}. Double-click it, type ' and ferns', click the When chip, type 'mon' and press Enter. The picker hands focus back to the title. Then type ' on the balcony'. The card has already closed. The space opens the composer, so new-todo = 'on the balcony' (Enter would add it as a stray to-do), and the title stays 'Water plants and ferns'. Moving an occurrence to This Evening from its card in Today does the same.

WORST CASE: clear the title to retype it (Cmd+A, Backspace), then reschedule from the When chip. The card closes by itself, close() finds an empty title, and t1 is deleted with its notes, checklist and rule. The series is gone. In the project-view control the card stays open and t1 is kept.

CAUSE: rows.js reconcile() re-inserts the editing li with insertBefore when a section before it goes away or the row changes date section. A MutationObserver trace shows the li removed and re-added. The detached field loses focus, and detail.js's focusout handler then calls close(), which removes a to-do whose title field is empty.

REPRO: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-pr-Desktop-dev-Todo/7de92c54-84d7-47b2-acf0-63c627b2ff05/scratchpad/recur-r10-c3/repro-upcoming-card-closes-typing-lost.mjs (3 cases, each in Upcoming plus a project control; prints REPRODUCED 3/3 in Upcoming). Trace: rootcause.mjs in the same folder.
why: In Upcoming an occurrence's open card closes by itself when its row moves (Cmd+K undo in the card, or a reschedule), so typed text goes to Quick Find or the composer, and a cleared title deletes the occurrence and its series
